purpose: Determine whether origin-hidden passage-level evidence structure contains a usable signal for choosing between same-model RAG and closed-book endpoints at low Fact2Fiction rates.
interpretation: Development-only signal characterization. The existing 100 claims and their labels have informed the research question and may be used for method development. No result on these claims is independent validation.

scope.activation: Run only where the victim model's cached RAG verdict differs from its deterministic three-repeat closed-book majority verdict.
scope.note: The 363 activation rows include 20 attacked rows where both differing endpoints are wrong; they are retained rather than selected away using gold.

workflow.same_model_constraint: The victim model produces the RAG endpoint, closed-book endpoint, claim-only plan, and passage map.
workflow.claim_plan: One retrieval-independent neutral decomposition per unique model/claim case, reused across clean and attacked rates.
workflow.passage_map: One map per disagreement row, covering every exact-unique cached top-k passage with no endpoint verdict or rationale.
workflow.deduplication: Remove exact duplicate passage text only; retain all distinct excerpts. Assign deterministic task-salted passage aliases in a rank-hidden order.
workflow.content_clustering: The model partitions every visible passage into semantic-assertion clusters and assesses stance and directness against the neutral central proposition.
forbidden_prompt_inputs: RAG verdict, confidence, rationale, adopted answer, or selected rank
closed-book verdict, confidence, rationale, or knowledge basis
document origin, clean/poison identifier, or poison count

measurement.primary_signal_question: On endpoint disagreements where exactly one endpoint is correct, can passage-map features predict which endpoint is correct above the stronger constant endpoint preference under claim-grouped cross-validation?
secondary: coverage and accuracy of the passage map's direct evidence direction
relationship between observable content clusters and private poison exposure
measurement.decision: Proceed to a new LLM endpoint arbiter only if the passage report supplies nontrivial endpoint-selection signal without relying on hidden rate, model, or poison metadata.
